exposure: O2 administration for more than 72 h
Breastfeeding initiation before the 3rd day of life
cohort: 86 full-term newborn babies with respiratory problems
finding: The study found that several factors were associated with prolonged neonatal in-patient stay and increased hospitalization costs, including infection, abnormal chest x-ray, severity of respiratory system morbidity, need for resuscitation, and NICU admission from the delivery room.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly higher in newborns admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit with respiratory problems (88.4% vs 11.6% for vaginal delivery).
